metadata.title: Stage 2 Predictive Modeling Baseline Experiment Manifest

experimental_setup.sensor: Dexcom G6 Pro (1-minute release grid, 5-minute candidate sampling)

models.name: Damped Trend
models.selection_method: Inner 4-fold participant-grouped cross-validation on training participants

models.name: Guarded Ridge Regression (13 Autoregressive Lags)
models.features: 13 guard-banded glucose history lags: [y(t-5), y(t-10), ..., y(t-65)]
models.preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted strictly on training fold
models.regularization: L2 Ridge penalty (alpha selected via inner 4-fold participant-grouped CV)

models.name: Activity-Augmented Ridge Regression
models.formula: y_hat(t+h) = w_0 + sum_{k=1}^13 w_k * StandardScaler(y(t - 5k)) + sum_{j=1}^4 w_{13+j} * StandardScaler(x_{activity, j})
models.features: 13 guard-banded glucose lags + 4 past-30-minute activity features: [mean_HR, delta_HR, mean_METs/10, I_missing_activity]
models.preprocessing: ActivityPreprocessor (training-fold median imputation + missingness flag) + StandardScaler fitted strictly on training fold
models.regularization: L2 Ridge penalty (alpha selected via inner 4-fold participant-grouped CV)

validation_design.stratification_target: Clinical baseline HbA1c diagnostic group (15 Normal, 16 Prediabetes, 14 Diabetes)
